_note: City landing pages are generated ONLY for entries that pass every gate in tools/build-city-pages.mjs. The list is intentionally empty: no city currently has verified fulfilment evidence and documented search demand. Do not add a city without both. No warehouses, stores, local offices or delivery promises may be invented.

_requiredFields.country: slug of a market in data/landing/markets.json
_requiredFields.lang: locale of an existing country page, for example en-GB

fulfilmentEvidence.source: carrier quote, contract or published policy

searchNeedEvidence.source: Search Console, Keyword Planner or another dated dataset

_requiredFields.nativeReviewed: true only after a named native reviewer signed off (required when lang is not English)
_requiredFields.intro: localized introduction written from verified facts
deliveryMethods: only methods named in the evidence
